title: Export Templates
description: One shared collection for your Godot projects.
sharedNotice: Changes here also affect Godot editors opened outside Godot Launcher. Each editor uses its matching version and edition.
scanIssues: Some content could not be identified or read. Totals exclude these entries; inspect them in the folder.
recoveryDetail: Close Godot before continuing. Recover the original files, or finish cleanup if the operation already completed.
closedEditors: I have closed Godot editors and exports that may use these templates.
mergeSummary: {{added}} files to add; {{identical}} identical files to reuse.
conflicts: These files differ. Choose which copy to keep. The other copy is removed only after the operation succeeds; unrelated files are preserved.
emptyDetail: Download an official package or import a .tpz file. Templates installed through Godot also appear here.
connectDetail: Reuse the shared folder. Existing local templates are reviewed before merging; other links remain unchanged.
wholePackages: Download a complete official package for one Godot version and edition. You do not need to install the editor first.
catalogueError: The catalogue could not be refreshed. Cached packages may still be available; local imports work offline.
removeDetail: Permanently remove this template set ({{size}})? Every editor using it will need the templates installed again.
usage: {{number}} registered projects use a matching editor. Other projects may also depend on these files.

connections.foreign: Existing link or file; inspect manually

errors.location: The default Godot template location is unavailable.
errors.unsafe: The folder or archive contains unsafe paths, links or unsupported entries. Existing files were preserved.
errors.changed: Files changed since review. Refresh and review them again before continuing.
errors.space: There is not enough free space for the download and temporary working files.
errors.identity: A valid, unambiguous Godot template version could not be identified. Inspect the package or local folder.
errors.archive: The template archive is damaged or could not be read.
errors.read: The shared folder could not be read. Check its location and permissions, then refresh.
errors.package: The selected official package is no longer available. Refresh the catalogue.
errors.connection: The project folder could not be connected. Existing files and links were preserved.
errors.busy: Another template operation is in progress. Wait for it to finish before continuing.
errors.decision: Choose which copy to keep for every conflicting file.
errors.recovery: An interrupted operation needs recovery. Close Godot and use Recover files. If files have changed, inspect the folders before retrying.
errors.failed: The operation could not complete. Check file permissions, available space and your connection, then retry.
errors.range: This server does not support partial downloads, or the package has changed. Reopen the selector or import a TPZ file.

picker.title: Add Export Template
picker.removalNotice: Removed files will no longer be available to projects using these shared templates.
picker.localOnly: Only installed files are available. Reopen this drawer with a connection to add official files.

migration.title: Migrate export templates
migration.introduction: Share export templates between projects to avoid keeping duplicate files.
migration.offerDetail: Choose what to do with existing project templates. Projects without local templates connect automatically. You can return later from Export Templates.
migration.explanation: Choose a project, decide which templates it should use, then review the changes. Other connected projects use the same shared files.
migration.selectProject: Select a project to see its templates and options.
migration.inspecting: Comparing this project with the shared templates...
migration.unverified: Existing files are unverified. Matching contents do not prove that a template is official or supports encryption. Keep custom or encryption-build templates separate unless you intend to share them.
migration.background: Submitted work continues when you close this window.

choices.separate: Keep this project's export templates separate
choices.use-shared: Delete local export templates and use shared

details.share-project: Add this project's missing export template files to the shared export templates folder. Existing shared export template files stay unchanged. This project then uses shared export templates; its local export templates are deleted.
details.use-shared: Delete this project's local export templates without adding them to the shared export templates folder. This project then uses shared export templates, even if none are installed for its Godot version yet.
details.separate: Keep using this project's local export templates. Nothing is copied to the shared export templates folder, and other projects are unaffected.

reasons.empty: No local template files to merge
reasons.foreign-link: Existing link or file: inspect manually
reasons.unexpected-content: Unrecognised contents: keep separate or inspect the folder
reasons.metadata-present: System metadata is present alongside template files
reasons.missing-editor: Editor environment unavailable: retry when accessible
reasons.unreadable: Folder unavailable: check permissions and retry
reasons.preference-mismatch: Marked separate but still connected: inspect the folder
reasons.active-operation: Another template operation is in progress
reasons.interrupted-operation: Recover the interrupted operation before migrating

migration.permanentDeletion: Local export templates are deleted permanently. No backup is kept.
